objects.description: [PowerSploit](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0194)'s Invoke-WmiCommand CodeExecution module uses WMI to execute and retrieve the output from a [PowerShell](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1086) payload.(Citation: GitHub PowerSploit May 2012)(Citation: PowerSploit Documentation)
objects.description_fa: [PowerSploit](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0194) Invoke-WmiCommand ماژول CodeExecution از WMI برای اجرا و بازیابی خروجی از یک [PowerShell] (https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1086) استفاده می‌کند. محموله.(Citation: GitHub PowerSploit May 2012)(Citation: PowerSploit Documentation)
